name: Shristi Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited
about: Shristi Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the construction and real estate business in India. It undertakes projects, including townships, residential, retail/malls and commercial, mixed-use developments, industrial parks and warehouses, education, healthcare, clubs and recreational facilities, and hospitality projects, as well as logistics hubs. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Kolkata, India. Shristi Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited operates as a subsidiary of Adishakti Commercial Private Limited.
